representativeQuote.text: knowledge of the ethical facts as David was just suggesting
representativeQuote.context: Clarke-Doane identifies the realist promise under examination before arguing that rival normative packages can preserve a further deliberative question.

con-objectivity-exceeds-mind-independenc.words: Stance-independent moral properties do not alone secure action-settling objectivity, because convention-independent rival normative packages can leave deliberation unresolved.
con-objectivity-exceeds-mind-independenc.critique: Strongest feature: The reply precisely distinguishes ordinary mind independence from the stronger action-settling objectivity required by the motion, preserves realism's genuine achievement, and directly tests whether recognized normative facts complete deliberation when rival convention-independent packages remain intelligible. Principal limitation: Its moral-twin iteration establishes a coherent possibility more readily than an independently evidenced prevalence or unavoidable feature of practical reasoning, so the gap's generality remains less firmly demonstrated than its intelligibility. Live burden: The account must explain why allegiance among rival packages remains substantively deliberative rather than merely redescribing uncertainty, error, or incomplete normative knowledge. Locked score: The very strong band reflects exceptional motion-level relevance, comprehensive responsiveness, stable qualification, and charitable representation, moderated principally by the conceptual rather than independently corroborated evidential basis.

con-metaphysical-privilege-dilemma.words: Metaphysical privilege cannot select an action-guiding package: nonnormative privilege is practically inert, whereas normative privilege recreates the selection question at another level.
con-metaphysical-privilege-dilemma.critique: Strongest feature: The dilemma supplies the con route's clearest mechanism, dividing metaphysical privilege into nonnormative and normative forms and explaining why the former lacks practical authority while the latter renews the privilege-versus-privilege-star question instead of terminating it. Principal limitation: The constructed horns receive targeted conceptual support, but practical inertness and recursive instability are not independently established, and a realist may contend that fundamental normative privilege legitimately ends explanation. Live burden: The reply must show that asking which higher-order standard governs is a genuine practical question rather than an indefinitely repeatable verbal demand applicable to every position. Locked score: The very strong band reflects decisive motion contact, unusually complete responsiveness, conceptual precision, and fair treatment of the realist endpoint, with evidential compression preventing an even stronger assessment.

con-decision-centered-noncognitivism.words: An attitude-centered view identifies what one ought to do with deciding or prescribing action, so adopting one option excludes incompatible alternatives without further package allegiance.
con-decision-centered-noncognitivism.critique: Strongest feature: The proposal answers the comparative-alternative demand directly by locating practical closure in deciding, prescribing, or adopting an action-directed attitude, thereby explaining structurally how one selected action excludes incompatible alternatives without relying on another truth-apt property's metaphysical privilege. Principal limitation: Building exclusion into the relevant attitude does not yet demonstrate that the attitude preserves ordinary objectivity, outperforms realist first-person closure, or avoids merely stipulating the desired connection between judgment and action. Live burden: The alternative must distinguish deliberative settlement from causal execution, accommodate akrasia, and specify how warranted criticism remains possible across conflicting prescriptions. Locked score: The very strong band recognizes central comparative relevance, coherent architecture, and broad responsiveness, while the proposal's acknowledged complications and underdeveloped objectivity-preserving resources constrain its evidential warrant.

con-deflationary-attitude-semantics.words: An attitude-centered noncognitivism can adopt deflationism and avoid inheriting the elaborate semantic machinery commonly associated with standard expressivist accounts.
con-deflationary-attitude-semantics.critique: Strongest feature: The reply narrows a potentially overbroad comparative objection by separating the proposed attitude-centered position from standard expressivist semantics and candidly presenting deflationism as an alternative orientation rather than pretending to have supplied a completed semantic theory. Principal limitation: Deflationism remains an underdefined pitch in the excerpt, leaving unexplained how the view handles compositional practice, disagreement, objectivity, practical psychology, and the other commitments implicated by the pro challenge. Live burden: The account must specify enough positive machinery to demonstrate genuine theoretical economy without quietly relocating complexity from semantics into pragmatics or attitudes. Locked score: The strong/competent band reflects clear subsidiary relevance, fair contact with a recognizable cost, appropriately limited asserted force, and stable scope, tempered by comparatively thin explanation and incomplete comparative evaluation.

con-reflective-logic-counterexample.words: An informed agent can know that an inference is classically valid yet recognize its invalidity under a rival logic, leaving rational settlement distinct from causal inference.
con-reflective-logic-counterexample.critique: Strongest feature: The rival-logics case directly challenges first-person deliberative closure with a structured informed counterexample, carefully separating causal production of an inference from its non-causal rational settlement when competing consequence relations classify the same transition differently. Principal limitation: The example defeats an unrestricted necessity claim more clearly than the realist's qualified normality claim, and its transfer from exceptionally reflective logical disputes to ordinary moral deliberation requires additional defense. Live burden: The counterexample must establish that the residual choice is practically substantive and sufficiently analogous to normative-package allegiance, rather than a localized uncertainty about the correct logic. Locked score: The very strong band reflects exceptional direct responsiveness, recoverable distinctions, proportionate possibility-level force, and charitable recognition of ordinary closure, with comparative rarity and cross-domain applicability limiting the warrant.

con-informed-deliberator-method.words: The importance of a deliberative anomaly should be tested among agents who understand the problem, rather than inferred from its absence among an unreflective majority.
con-informed-deliberator-method.critique: Strongest feature: The methodological reply identifies a relevant population for testing reflective anomalies, explaining why raw prevalence among people unfamiliar with the problem cannot determine whether informed deliberation contains a persistent structural gap. Principal limitation: Awareness is not yet operationalized as understanding, no selection or measurement procedure is supplied, and specialist responses might reflect training artifacts rather than a central feature of practical reasoning. Live burden: The method must define informed competence, compare responses systematically, and show why those responses illuminate deliberation's explanatory structure without replacing centrality with a different headcount. Locked score: The strong/competent band reflects meaningful contact with anomaly weighting, a plausible and tentatively calibrated methodological insight, and charitable engagement, while sparse evidence and an undeveloped sampling criterion substantially restrict its independent force.

con-foundational-anomaly-significance.words: Rare, apparently baroque foundational anomalies may expose transformative structural defects and therefore cannot receive negligible weight merely because ordinary practice otherwise succeeds.
con-foundational-anomaly-significance.critique: Strongest feature: The reply resists frequency-based discounting through foundational analogies, explaining how an apparently baroque anomaly can disclose a transformative defect even when ordinary practice functions smoothly, while restating the possible deliberative distance between knowing a fact and regulating behavior by it. Principal limitation: Russell-style and scientific-change comparisons establish possible significance, not that this particular normative anomaly is comparably foundational, so the analogy still needs a domain-specific bridge. Live burden: The argument must demonstrate that rival-package deliberation reveals the architecture of normative guidance rather than merely an exceptional complication at its theoretical margins. Locked score: The very strong band reflects direct engagement with centrality weighting, concrete analogical support, careful possibility-level calibration, and strong charity, moderated by the unfinished inference from foundational exemplars to the target phenomenon.

con-contradictions-as-defeasible-costs.words: Paraconsistent logic shows that contradiction can be a defeasible theoretical price rather than automatic defeat, placing it on a continuum with explanatory anomalies.
con-contradictions-as-defeasible-costs.critique: Strongest feature: The reply contests the categorical contrast through paraconsistent logic, showing contradiction as survivable and defeasible, thereby supporting comparative evaluation of logical and explanatory costs rather than automatic theoretical defeat. Principal limitation: Survivability cannot establish that contradictions and ordinary explanatory awkwardness inhabit a homogeneous continuum, since contradictions may preserve distinctive inferential consequences even where explosion is blocked. Live burden: The position must articulate principled dimensions for comparing heterogeneous costs and demonstrate their application to the deliberative anomaly, rather than resting on abstract logical possibility. Locked score: The very strong band reflects recognizable conceptual support, explicit qualification, close engagement with the opposing distinction, and proportionate force, while compressed applicability and the unresolved severity comparison constrain its broader contribution.

strengths: Distinguished mind-independent truth from action-settling objectivity and consistently connected that distinction to the motion's demanding deliberative requirement.
Developed a two-horn privilege dilemma that directly answered both the realist ontology and the attempt to dismiss iteration as a pseudo-problem.
Supplied an identifiable attitude-centered alternative, thereby meeting the comparative burden rather than relying exclusively on internal criticism of realism.
Used an informed rival-logics case to separate causal compliance from rational settlement and to challenge universalized first-person closure.
Defended the possible theoretical importance of rare foundational anomalies without overstating them as guaranteed refutations of the realist framework.

blunders.text: The deflationary alternative remained substantially programmatic and did not explain how objectivity, disagreement, compositional practice, and action guidance would be jointly preserved.
The informed-deliberator proposal lacked a developed competence criterion, sampling method, or safeguard against treating specialist artifacts as evidence about deliberation generally.
Several foundational and logical analogies established intelligible possibilities more securely than they established direct applicability to ordinary moral deliberation.

thesis.text: AI steelman: Stance-independent moral facts may secure truth beyond preference while still failing, by themselves, to determine action, because practical settlement requires a justified commitment procedure that selects among intelligible rival normative packages.

novelty.explanation: This steelman repairs the gap argument by adding a positive commitment procedure instead of relying only on recursive challenges to realist privilege.

premises.text: If two stance-independent packages issue incompatible recommendations and an agent understands both, merely identifying which package is metaphysically privileged does not settle action unless that privilege itself supplies a practical reason for allegiance.

novelty.explanation: This develops the distinction between metaphysical ranking and practically action-guiding authority.

premises.text: A nonnormative fact about privilege cannot generate practical authority without a bridge principle, while a normative bridge principle remains assessable under the same question of which normative standard an agent should follow.

novelty.explanation: This makes each horn explicit and identifies the bridge principle required for practical relevance.

premises.text: A decision-centered account can close deliberation without denying truth-apt moral discourse if it distinguishes the representational content considered during reasoning from the action-committing attitude that completes reasoning.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the alternative by separating deliberative representation from the commitment that excludes incompatible actions.

premises.text: Reflective counterexamples matter when they isolate a structural feature of guidance, but their significance should depend on diagnostic relevance and informed reproducibility rather than either population frequency or philosophical vividness alone.

novelty.explanation: This supplies stricter criteria for using rare informed cases and repairs the undeveloped sampling method.

premises.text: Theoretical costs are heterogeneous and defeasible, so comparisons should track inferential disruption, explanatory reach, practical consequences, and repair costs instead of treating contradiction or rarity as categorically decisive.

novelty.explanation: This adds principled dimensions for comparing logical and explanatory anomalies.

conclusion.text: Therefore, realism alone does not yet vindicate action-settling objectivity unless it explains how recognized normative facts rationally authorize allegiance, while a suitably developed decision-centered account remains a credible comparative alternative rather than a completed theory.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion proportionately combines the negative burden on realism with a qualified, nonfinal claim for the alternative.

newArguments.title: Commitment-procedure asymmetry
newArguments.text: A theory can represent reasons accurately yet remain incomplete as a theory of practical settlement if it supplies no account of rational commitment. The relevant comparison is therefore not facts versus attitudes in isolation, but rival procedures for moving from represented considerations to an exclusionary commitment. Realism may contribute indispensable content while an attitude-centered procedure contributes closure. Unless realism explains that transition without presupposing the disputed package, its ontology does not uniquely perform the action-settling work claimed for it.

novelty.explanation: This newly distinguishes representational accuracy from procedural completion and evaluates theories by their allocation of those functions.

newArguments.title: Diagnostic invariance test
newArguments.text: A reflective anomaly deserves substantial weight when it persists under changes that remove merely verbal, sociological, and informational explanations. Test whether informed agents still face the residual question after terminology is standardized, factual ignorance is corrected, consequences are made explicit, and rival standards are represented symmetrically. Persistence across those interventions would support a structural deliberative gap; disappearance would favor the realist diagnosis of confusion or incomplete understanding. This test converts the informed-deliberator suggestion into a comparative method rather than an appeal to specialist reactions.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the sampling proposal with controlled diagnostic conditions and an outcome that can also count against the con position.
